Querulous Qwilfish (Japanese: VS ハリーセン VS ), titled VS Qwilfish in the Chuang Yi translation, is the 122nd chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 32nd chapter of the .

==Plot==
 
 is walking towards Olivine City, with the news broadcast about the events of the Burned Tower playing. Once she enters Olivine City, she sees the construction site of the . When she gets to the construction site, she talks to one of the workers about when it will be finished. Suddenly, a waste collection pipe starts to break under pressure, and the tower itself starts to collapse. Crystal manages to save some of the workers, but the waste flows into the sea, enraging some nearby .

The Qwilfish take in a bunch of water and start attacking with . Crystal thinks about cleaning up the mess to calm the Pokémon down, but decides to capture them instead. She then sends out all her Pokémon, who fight the Qwilfish, and Crystal kicks s to capture them once they are defeated. The workers say that they will clean up the mess soon. However, spots a baby Qwilfish in the water. Crystal has Natee rescue the Qwilfish from the water and notices that it has a weak pulse.

As Crystal is about to take the baby Qwilfish to a Pokémon Center, suddenly appears in front of her and cures the baby Qwilfish, cleaning the sea in the process. Soon, Crystal gets a call from , telling her that he's counting on her to get some data on the three . Crystal tells him what she just saw and then starts hunting down Suicune.

==Major events==
encounters at the construction site.
